`producer-v1-basket2.tar.gz` was generated by the 0.2.0 producer's offline
`test_public_runner_native_artifact_workflow[2]` with a provider-free executable
fixture, real Git/bubblewrap and host rescore/reprice operations. It contains
report/run/state/archive v1 and an unchanged basket v2. It includes the old
calculator snapshot and source identity fields as archived historical evidence.

The producer used `--basetemp=/tmp/prsim-legacy-public-fixture` so diagnostic
paths contain no personal workspace names.

No model request, credentials, production run or external upload was used.
Temporary paths in diagnostic logs are inert evidence. Tests must read the
original archive bytes; they must not upgrade its version fields or rewrite it.
